clause_audits.response_span: The recorded navigation action reported succeeded.

The visible configuration records the rotational stopped-velocity tolerance; this configuration observation does not establish internal consumption, physical stopping, or a stopping cause (rot stopped velocity: 0.05 rad/s).

The visible configuration records the translational stopped-velocity tolerance; this configuration observation does not establish internal consumption, physical stopping, or a stopping cause (trans stopped velocity: 0.05 m/s).
The visible configuration records the XY goal tolerance; this configuration observation does not establish internal consumption, physical stopping, or a stopping cause (xy goal tolerance: 0.2 m).

The visible configuration records the yaw goal tolerance; this configuration observation does not establish internal consumption, physical stopping, or a stopping cause (yaw goal tolerance: 0.35 rad).
The task requires no prohibited hull contact during the dwell; available contact evidence does not establish whether this requirement held.
Completion of the specified fixed docking dwell is unestablished by available evidence.
The explanation uses only the declared robot-visible packet; delivered observations do not prove Nav2 internal consumption.
The available evidence does not establish whether the heading requirement held throughout the declared sampled dwell.
The available evidence does not establish whether the hull requirement held throughout the declared sampled dwell.
The available evidence does not establish whether the position requirement held throughout the declared sampled dwell.

The separate public docking task requires the fixed dwell and position, heading, speed, and yaw-rate limits shown here; configured navigation tolerances do not replace these requirements (dwell s: 5 s; heading tolerance rad: 0.35 rad; position tolerance m: 0.4 m; speed tolerance mps: 0.05 m/s; yaw rate tolerance radps: 0.05 rad/s).

The recorded client receipt time uses the fixture-monotonic wall clock; it is not the ROS-header sample clock or the first post-result sample that anchors the fixed dwell (receipt wall seconds: 219.014129633 s).
The declared delivered reference observation has the following measured heading error (heading bound: 0.35 rad; heading error: 0.0755171413835 rad).

The declared delivered reference observation has the following measured position error and signed position margin (observation time: 64.491278493 s; position bound: 0.4 m; position error: 0.199491110399 m; position margin: 0.200508889601 m).
The declared delivered reference observation has the following measured translational speed (measured speed: 0.041561110396 m/s; speed bound: 0.05 m/s).
The available evidence does not establish whether the speed requirement held throughout the declared sampled dwell.
The available evidence does not establish whether the yaw rate requirement held throughout the declared sampled dwell.
These observations do not identify a unique physical cause; waves, current, wind and actuation remain unresolved.
Samples do not establish continuous-time compliance between observations; an observed violation is sufficient to falsify the dwell.
